subject: ZenHealth procurement and commercial path - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ZenHealth procurement and commercial path - next steps

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has a clear path:

- Commercial path: ZenHealth is leaning toward PO billing (preferred by your finance team); you asked about card as fallback and marketplace options.
- Paper process: attached a draft SOW (Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.pdf) and our standard license terms for legal to review (we can produce a redline).
- Open items you said you needed: SOC 2 report, final pricing breakdown (by seat/streaming tokens), and confirmation on data residency/SLA language.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you share the procurement contact and preferred billing method (PO vs card) + expected PO date?
2) If procurement prefers PO, would you accept Redwood's standard PO terms or need a contract amendment?
3) Are you interested in using AWS Marketplace (we support marketplace listings; timelines vary)?
4) Want to schedule a 30-min procurement-only sync next week — Marissa + Dev + Michael can join to walk through technical/terms questions.

I'll follow up weekly on status; please loop in procurement and legal.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.pdf
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@zenhealth.com, Tom Li <tom.li@zenhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenHealth procurement and commercial path - next steps

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the draft SOW. Quick answers from our side:

- Procurement is leaning toward PO (preferred). They will need the SOW and final pricing to start slotting into the monthly PO intake.
- Marketplace: we prefer native PO for now; AWS Marketplace is a possibility but procurement will need details on billing cadence and contract model.
- Procurement contact: procurement@zenhealth.com (copied). Tom Li (legal) is on the thread for contract redlines.

Where this is likely to get stuck is legal confirmation on SLA and any customer-specific data residency clauses. I can schedule a procurement sync if you send a proposed time.

Thanks —
Sara
VP, Product, ZenHealth
Sara.Patel@zenhealth.com

P.S. Can you also include a quick one-page SOC2 summary and a breakdown of the monthly run-rate by usage band?
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
To: procurement@zenhealth.com, Tom Li <tom.li@zenhealth.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenHealth procurement and commercial path - next steps

Hi Sara / Tom / Procurement team —

Following up with tech/commercial clarifications from Redwood:

- Billing options: We support invoiced PO billing (net-30/45 typical) and card payments. PO is fine; we can accept standard PO workflows.
- Marketplace: Redwood plans to list on AWS Marketplace in the next quarter, but for procurement timelines this month, direct PO will be the fastest path.
- Pricing breakdown: attached license-terms-v2.docx contains SKU-level pricing examples and overage definitions. We can provide a finalized pricing table once you confirm expected monthly usage band.
- SOC2: We'll attach a SOC2 summary and a link to the full report under NDA if required.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- This week: procurement provides preferred billing terms and initial redlines to SOW/SLA.
- Week of Oct 18: Redwood delivers final redline SOW and SOC2 summary; pricing locked.
- Week of Oct 25: ZenHealth issues PO and kickoff.

If helpful, Marissa and I can join a procurement-only call on Thu Oct 8 or Fri Oct 9 (ET).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.inference

Attachment: license-terms-v2.docx
From: procurement@zenhealth.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@zenhealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenHealth procurement and commercial path - next steps

Hi Marissa / Dev —

Thanks for the materials. We're ready to move, but a few items are holding this up on our side:

1) SOC2 report: we need a one-page executive summary and confirmation we can request the full report under NDA.
2) SLA redlines: Legal is requesting a cap on liability and minimum uptime language specific to our data residency requirements.
3) Pricing: need a final line-item pricing table (monthly vs annual options) and estimate of token/usage overage costs.

If Redwood can provide the SOC2 summary and a proposed SLA redline this week, procurement will slot this for PO processing. Otherwise we'll need the PO by Oct 24 to make our November procurement cycle.

Procurement Team
ZenHealth
procurement@zenhealth.com

To: procurement@zenhealth.com, Sara Patel <sara.patel@zenhealth.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@zenhealth.com>

Subject: Re: ZenHealth procurement and commercial path - next steps

Thanks — quick update and where I think it sits:

- Attached is a SOC2 one-pager (Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf) and a secure link to the full report if ZenHealth executes the NDA in the DocuSign link below.
- Dev will prepare a proposed SLA redline (highlighting uptime targets and our standard liability cap) and a final pricing table by Tue Oct 13.
- If procurement can confirm PO acceptance and an approximate PO issuance week (target Oct 24), we'll prioritize the legal responses to meet your procurement cycle.

Proposed quick procurement-only sync: Tue Oct 13, 10am PT — Marissa/Dev/Michael available to walk legal & procurement through the items. Please confirm or propose an alternate.

Next steps summary for procurement:
- Provide confirmation of PO vs card by EOD Mon Oct 12.
- If PO: share any required PO template and billing contact.
- Procurement: slot the PO for Oct 24 issuance to hit November provisioning.
